name: Yato Kukuru
source:
[b]An Outstanding Engineer Boasting Overwhelming Wealth[/b]

Kukuru may just be a first-year student, but she calls the shots as the General Head of all the cultural clubs in the school.

A trailblazing genius, she's among the nation's foremost researchers in automata theory and stands at the cutting edge of artificial intelligence development. A rationalist to the core, Kukuru ruthlessly cuts away anything that doesn't serve her research. Socializing and savoring a good meal aren't even on her radar—it's all work and no play.

Her research demands colossal funding, but leveraging the investment acumen inherited from her parents, she single-handedly amassed a vast fortune. Many clubs have dipped into Kukuru's personal coffers for loans, leaving them indebted and unable to bite the hand that feeds them.

"...Unbelievably stupid. I'm just done."

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://selectoblige.com/character]official website[/url]]
